description: A React component for the Tic Tac Toe game that manages game state, handles user interactions, and renders the game interface.

methods.name: Game
methods.description: The default exported function that renders the Game component.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles the click event on a cell in the game board, updates the game state, and checks for a winner or draw.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the game state to the initial state.

methods.name: handleModeChange
methods.description: Changes the game mode and resets the game state accordingly.
